messages:
Maya (CTO): Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Dropping a short follow-up thread for Q&A items, clarifications, and owners. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you own an item and update the thread when it's done.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.redwood/recording/abc123 — Slides: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/2026-03-23/slides.pdf :link:

Jordan (Product): Quick clarifying Q from the live Q&A — when you said 'marketplace in H2', do you mean a Q3 beta or just exploratory work?

Maya (CTO): Good callout. Short answer: Q3 beta for a limited set of partners, GA target Q4. We'll publish a short roadmap note tomorrow. @Jordan to own the public roadmap update. :spiral_notepad:

Priya (Eng): Re: latency SLOs mentioned — would an internal baseline doc help? I can export p50/p95 for hosted vs dedicated for the models we demoed.

Maya (CTO): Yes please. Priya, can you include model name, sequence length, config (batch size / kv cache), and test harness command? Put the doc in #docs and paste the link here.

Priya (Eng): Will do. ETA: EOD Friday. Example command I'll share as a starting point: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/bench -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","seq":512,"batch":1}'
```

Sam (SRE): We had a couple of questions about escalation for Dedicated customers during the ops segment. Can we confirm on-call owners & runbook link? @Lina (People Ops)

Lina (People Ops): Confirmed — on-call rotation for Dedicated is in the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/dedicated-oncall Owners: Sam, Diego, Harpreet. I'll add a 1-paragraph note to the all-hands follow-up doc and tag the infra leads. :white_check_mark:

Alex (CEO): Small ask from growth: can product share a one-pager on marketplace packaging and pricing assumptions? That will help customer conversations this week. @Jordan

Jordan (Product): Creating the 1-pager now. I'll post the draft here by Monday and loop in growth and solutions. :memo:

Maya (CTO): Action items summary (owners): 1) Roadmap post explaining Q3 beta / Q4 GA (Jordan) 2) Latency baseline doc with harness & numbers (Priya) 3) On-call note + runbook pointer (Lina) 4) Marketplace 1-pager for GTM (Jordan). Please update this thread when items move to done.

Priya (Eng): Pushed a quick gist with raw CSV export for initial latency runs: https://gist.github.com/priya/latency-run-2026 — I'll follow up with a cleaned doc in #docs.

Jordan (Product): Draft roadmap posted: https://docs.google.com/draft/redwood-marketplace-roadmap Feedback welcome, esp on the beta partner criteria. I'll update based on comments and ping product-announce when finalized.

Maya (CTO): Thanks all — closing the live thread here. If you have follow-ups after these items are done, start a fresh thread or DM the owners. tagging owners: @Jordan @Priya @Lina :rocket:
